competency_fulfillment.rationale: Both verbs of the competency are attempted - identifying a fraction from a shown model and representing one by shading a shape - and the keys I could verify, such as the one-fifth number-line item, name genuine unit fractions with the numerator held at one.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The competency lists six denominators explicitly and one of them, 6, does not appear in a single sample. Meanwhile halves account for five of the nine items, so the set is simultaneously missing a required denominator and over-weighted on the easiest one.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Stems are one short instruction each, the fractions carry a numerator of one throughout, and the inverted-notation decoys target exactly the confusion a beginner has about which number sits on top.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Four separate seeds produce the identical instruction 'Shade 1/2 of the shape.' with the same answer, so the representing half of this node is effectively a single item reissued, and only one sample uses a number line rather than an area model.

competency_alignment.rationale: Rather than stepping through the named denominators from halves toward eighths, the sampled set clusters on the easiest one, so the progression does not build the pupil's grasp of how a larger denominator means a smaller part.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: No denominator exceeds eight and no numerator exceeds one, so the items stay inside the unit-fraction band this quarter defines, with the eighths ceiling reached.
